name: counter_kind
description: The counter kind a hit meets (0 none, 1 Counterattack or Magic Counter, 2 Evade and Counter) and the arming of the target's counter byte: single-target commands only, never against an attacker that is itself in a reaction, never against itself, never with the duel switch off; the byte is set when the kind is not 0 and the command is harmful.

function.signature: int counter_kind(int arm, int userId, Chr *user, int targetId, Chr *target, Cmd *cmd, int *scratch)

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; the three status-flag tables read from the exe memory; queue inserts hooked

notes: in.df1 is the attacker's Chr+0xdf1, in.auto6bc the target's Chr+0x6bc, in.armed the target's armed byte before the call; in.cmd holds Cmd+0x1a (b1a), +0x20 (b20), +0x23 (b23) and the extra-status word +0x54.

in.chances is [status number, byte] pairs (Cmd+0x2e on), in.durations [temporal slot, byte] pairs (Cmd+0x47 on); out.armed is the byte afterwards; arm 0 is the call at the start of a hit (it never arms), arm 1 the call at the end.
